input: same selected bouts, rank<=k, [visits,k,4]; no metadata as predictors
architecture: Linear(4,width), ReLU per bout; mean across bouts; Linear(width,width/2), ReLU, Linear(width/2,1)
loss: person-weighted SmoothL1 beta=.5 on training-standardized target
preprocessing: training-only person-weighted X mean/std across raw selected bouts, each visit contributes weight/k to each bout; training-only weighted y mean/std
inner_folds: same seed and person 3-fold as reference MLP
selection: minimum combined inner-validation person MAE over width and epoch
draws: fit draw0; evaluate draw0/1/2 separately, no averaging predictions
uncertainty: paired person bootstrap of fixed OOF predictions; not refitting and not independent final validation
scope: small mean-pooled Deep Sets, not all possible set architectures; raw bout summaries, not raw motion time series
